name: transfer-deployment-data
description: Copy data from one Tamanu deployment into another through their HTTP APIs: reference data, facilities and locations, users, programs and forms, settings, and patients with their details, summaries and appointments, plus full clinical history for patients the user names. Use when asked to pull across, copy, migrate or mirror data from a deployment (e.g. 'bring the data from presentation.demos.tamanu.app into my PR deploy'). To create new data, use seed-demo-data. Never writes to the source, and never targets production.
